_help: FC Mod Helper scout preview settings. Change the numbers, save, then press Scout preview again. Stars: a player gets the stars of the first line his potential reaches. Sign him: up to 'how_many' unsigned players with the best score get the badge. Score = potential + young bonus + PlayStyles+ bonus.
_help_range: GUESS: the game shows a potential range on screen. FIFA 18's scout.ini (POTENTIAL_VARIANCE_PERC_0..5) set its width in percent, picked by the player's 'potentialvariance' number. FC 26 values are unknown, so these are the FIFA 18 ones.
